# KMP-FaceLink

> Unified face, hand, and body tracking SDK for Kotlin Multiplatform. One API across Android (MediaPipe + CameraX), iOS (ARKit + Vision), JVM/Desktop (ONNX Runtime), and Wasm (MediaPipe JS). Provides 52 ARKit-compatible blend shapes, head transform, hand landmarks, gesture classification, and body pose estimation via a reactive Kotlin Flow API.

KMP-FaceLink is an MIT-licensed open-source library published as `io.github.rioX432:kmp-facelink` on Maven Central. It is designed to be modular: import only the modules you need.

## Platform Support

| Platform | Face Tracking | Hand Tracking | Body Tracking | Engine |
|----------|--------------|---------------|---------------|--------|
| Android (SDK 24+) | MediaPipe Face Landmarker | MediaPipe Hand Landmarker | MediaPipe Pose Landmarker | CameraX |
| iOS (17.0+) | ARKit (TrueDepth camera) | Vision (VNDetectHumanHandPoseRequest) | Vision (VNDetectHumanBodyPoseRequest) | AVCaptureSession |
| JVM/Desktop | ONNX Runtime (OpenSeeFace) | ONNX Runtime | ONNX Runtime | Webcam via JavaCV |
| Wasm/JS | MediaPipe JS interop | Stub (no-op) | Stub (no-op) | Browser WebAssembly GC |

## Core Module: kmp-facelink

### Factory Functions

```kotlin
// Package: io.github.kmpfacelink.api
fun createFaceTracker(context: PlatformContext, config: FaceTrackerConfig = FaceTrackerConfig()): FaceTracker
fun createHandTracker(context: PlatformContext, config: HandTrackerConfig = HandTrackerConfig()): HandTracker
fun createBodyTracker(context: PlatformContext, config: BodyTrackerConfig = BodyTrackerConfig()): BodyTracker
fun createHolisticTracker(context: PlatformContext, config: HolisticTrackerConfig): HolisticTracker
```

### FaceTracker Interface

```kotlin
interface FaceTracker : Releasable {
    val trackingData: Flow<FaceTrackingData>
    val state: StateFlow<TrackingState>
    val errorMessage: StateFlow<String?>
    suspend fun start()
    suspend fun stop()
    fun release()
    fun resetCalibration()
    fun updateSmoothing(config: SmoothingConfig)
    suspend fun switchCamera(facing: CameraFacing)
}
```

HandTracker and BodyTracker follow the same pattern with their respective data types.

### TrackingState Enum

```kotlin
enum class TrackingState { IDLE, STARTING, TRACKING, STOPPED, ERROR, RELEASED }
```

### FaceTrackingData

```kotlin
data class FaceTrackingData(
    val blendShapes: BlendShapeData,        // Map of 52 ARKit blend shape values (0.0-1.0)
    val headTransform: HeadTransform,       // 6DoF head position and rotation
    val gazeData: GazeData?,                // Eye gaze direction (nullable)
    val landmarks: List<FaceLandmark>,      // 478 points (Android/MediaPipe), empty (iOS/ARKit)
    val sourceImageWidth: Int,
    val sourceImageHeight: Int,
    val timestampMs: Long,
    val isTracking: Boolean,
    val faces: List<TrackedFace>,           // Multi-face tracking support
    val thermalState: ThermalState,
)
```

### HandTrackingData

```kotlin
data class HandTrackingData(
    val hands: List<TrackedHand>,           // Per-hand landmarks + gesture + handedness
    val timestampMs: Long,
    val isTracking: Boolean,
)
```

### BodyTrackingData

```kotlin
data class BodyTrackingData(
    val bodies: List<TrackedBody>,          // Body pose landmarks (33 keypoints)
    val timestampMs: Long,
    val isTracking: Boolean,
)
```

### BlendShape Enum (52 ARKit-compatible values)

Eyes (14): EYE_BLINK_LEFT, EYE_BLINK_RIGHT, EYE_LOOK_DOWN_LEFT, EYE_LOOK_DOWN_RIGHT, EYE_LOOK_IN_LEFT, EYE_LOOK_IN_RIGHT, EYE_LOOK_OUT_LEFT, EYE_LOOK_OUT_RIGHT, EYE_LOOK_UP_LEFT, EYE_LOOK_UP_RIGHT, EYE_SQUINT_LEFT, EYE_SQUINT_RIGHT, EYE_WIDE_LEFT, EYE_WIDE_RIGHT

Jaw (4): JAW_FORWARD, JAW_LEFT, JAW_RIGHT, JAW_OPEN

Mouth (15): MOUTH_CLOSE, MOUTH_FUNNEL, MOUTH_PUCKER, MOUTH_LEFT, MOUTH_RIGHT, MOUTH_SMILE_LEFT, MOUTH_SMILE_RIGHT, MOUTH_FROWN_LEFT, MOUTH_FROWN_RIGHT, MOUTH_DIMPLE_LEFT, MOUTH_DIMPLE_RIGHT, MOUTH_STRETCH_LEFT, MOUTH_STRETCH_RIGHT, MOUTH_ROLL_LOWER, MOUTH_ROLL_UPPER

More mouth (4): MOUTH_SHRUG_LOWER, MOUTH_SHRUG_UPPER, MOUTH_PRESS_LEFT, MOUTH_PRESS_RIGHT

Lips (6): MOUTH_LOWER_DOWN_LEFT, MOUTH_LOWER_DOWN_RIGHT, MOUTH_UPPER_UP_LEFT, MOUTH_UPPER_UP_RIGHT, MOUTH_SMILE_LEFT, MOUTH_SMILE_RIGHT

Brow (4): BROW_DOWN_LEFT, BROW_DOWN_RIGHT, BROW_INNER_UP, BROW_OUTER_UP_LEFT, BROW_OUTER_UP_RIGHT

Nose (2): NOSE_SNEER_LEFT, NOSE_SNEER_RIGHT

Cheek (3): CHEEK_PUFF, CHEEK_SQUINT_LEFT, CHEEK_SQUINT_RIGHT

Tongue (1): TONGUE_OUT

### SmoothingConfig

```kotlin
sealed class SmoothingConfig {
    object None : SmoothingConfig()
    data class Ema(val alpha: Float = 0.5f) : SmoothingConfig()
    data class OneEuro(val minCutoff: Float = 1.0f, val beta: Float = 0.007f, val dCutoff: Float = 1.0f) : SmoothingConfig()
    data class CategoryAware(...) : SmoothingConfig()  // Per-region OneEuro tuning
}
```

### FaceTrackerConfig

```kotlin
data class FaceTrackerConfig(
    val smoothingConfig: SmoothingConfig = SmoothingConfig.Ema(alpha = 0.5f),
    val cameraFacing: CameraFacing = CameraFacing.FRONT,
    val maxFaces: Int = 1,                              // 1-4 simultaneous faces
    val powerMode: PowerMode? = null,                   // Performance, Balanced, PowerSaver
    val enhancerConfig: BlendShapeEnhancerConfig = ..., // Geometric enhancement (Android)
)
```

### PlatformContext

```kotlin
// Android
PlatformContext(context: Context, lifecycleOwner: LifecycleOwner)

// iOS
PlatformContext()  // No parameters needed

// JVM
PlatformContext()

// Wasm
PlatformContext()
```

## Avatar Module: kmp-facelink-avatar

Maps tracking data to avatar engine parameters.

### Live2D Mapping

```kotlin
val mapper = Live2DParameterMapper()
faceTracker.trackingData.collect { data ->
    val params: Map<String, Float> = mapper.map(data)
    // Keys: ParamAngleX, ParamAngleY, ParamAngleZ, ParamEyeLOpen, ParamEyeROpen,
    //        ParamMouthOpenY, ParamMouthForm, ParamBrowLY, ParamBrowRY,
    //        ParamEyeBallX, ParamEyeBallY, ParamCheek, ...
}
```

### VRM Mapping

```kotlin
val vrmMapper = VrmParameterMapper(version = VrmVersion.V1_0)
faceTracker.trackingData.collect { data ->
    val expressions: Map<String, Float> = vrmMapper.map(data)
    // Keys: happy, angry, sad, relaxed, surprised, lookLeft, lookRight, ...
}
```

## Actions Module: kmp-facelink-actions

### ActionSystem

```kotlin
val actionSystem = ActionSystem()

// Gesture trigger
actionSystem.register(
    ActionBinding(
        trigger = GestureTrigger(gesture = HandGesture.VICTORY, holdTimeMs = 500),
        cooldownMs = 1000,
    )
)

// Expression trigger
actionSystem.register(
    ActionBinding(
        trigger = ExpressionTrigger(blendShape = BlendShape.EYE_BLINK_LEFT, threshold = 0.8f),
    )
)

// Collect events
actionSystem.events.collect { event -> println("Action: ${event.bindingId}") }

// Feed data
faceTracker.trackingData.collect { actionSystem.processFace(it) }
handTracker.trackingData.collect { actionSystem.processHand(it) }
```

### EmotionClassifier

```kotlin
val classifier = EmotionClassifier()
faceTracker.trackingData.collect { data ->
    val result: EmotionResult = classifier.classify(data.blendShapes)
    // result.emotion (e.g., "happy"), result.confidence (e.g., 0.87)
}
```

### HandGesture Enum

VICTORY, THUMB_UP, THUMB_DOWN, OPEN_PALM, CLOSED_FIST, POINTING_UP, NONE

## Voice Module: kmp-facelink-voice (Experimental)

```kotlin
val voicePipeline = VoicePipeline(config)

// TTS with lip sync
voicePipeline.speak("Hello!").collect { lipSyncFrame ->
    // lipSyncFrame.blendShapes — mouth shapes synchronized to audio
}

// ASR
voicePipeline.startListening()
voicePipeline.transcriptions.collect { text -> println("User said: $text") }
```

Backends: ASR via Whisper (on-device whisper.cpp), TTS via OpenAI TTS / ElevenLabs / Voicevox (on-device).

## LLM Module: kmp-facelink-llm (Experimental)

```kotlin
// Cloud
val client = LlmClient.create(LlmConfig.OpenAi(apiKey = "sk-...", model = "gpt-4o-mini"))

// On-device
val onDevice = LlmClient.create(LlmConfig.OnDevice(modelId = "gemma-3n-e2b-int4"))

// Hybrid routing (simple -> on-device, complex -> cloud)
val hybrid = LlmClient.create(
    LlmConfig.Hybrid(
        onDeviceConfig = LlmConfig.OnDevice(modelId = "gemma-3n-e2b-int4"),
        cloudConfig = LlmConfig.OpenAi(apiKey = "sk-..."),
        routingStrategy = RoutingStrategy.Auto(complexityThreshold = 0.5f),
    )
)

// Streaming chat
val history = ConversationHistory()
history.addUser("Hello!")
client.chat(history).collect { token -> print(token) }
```

## Pipeline Module: kmp-facelink-pipeline (Experimental)

Orchestrates: ASR -> LLM -> TTS -> LipSync -> Expression.

```kotlin
val pipeline = buildAvatarPipeline {
    llm(LlmConfig.OpenAi(apiKey = "sk-...", model = "gpt-4o-mini"))
    persona(PersonaConfig(name = "Ai", systemPrompt = "You are a friendly assistant"))
    ttsEngine(myTtsEngine)
    lipSyncEngine(myLipSyncEngine)
    expressionBlendRatio(0.7f)
}

pipeline.start()
pipeline.listen()  // Voice input mode: ASR -> LLM -> TTS -> lip sync
pipeline.processText("Tell me a joke")  // Text input mode

pipeline.output.collect { frame ->
    // frame.blendShapes — combined tracking + lip sync + emotion
    // frame.audioChunk — TTS audio to play
    // frame.text — LLM response text
}
```

## Interact Module: kmp-facelink-interact

Streaming platform event sources for audience interaction. Connect to Twitch EventSub, YouTube Live Chat, or use MockStreamEventSource for demo/testing.

### StreamEventSource Interface

```kotlin
interface StreamEventSource {
    val events: Flow<StreamEvent>
    val connectionState: StateFlow<ConnectionState>
    val platform: StreamPlatform
    suspend fun connect()
    suspend fun disconnect()
}
```

### StreamEvent Types

```kotlin
sealed class StreamEvent {
    abstract val platform: StreamPlatform
    abstract val timestampMs: Long
    abstract val author: String
}
// Subtypes: ChatMessage, Gift, Follow, Raid, ChannelPointRedemption, SuperChat
```

### EffectParameter Types

```kotlin
sealed class EffectParameter {
    abstract val durationMs: Long
    abstract val intensity: Float
    // ThrowEffect — throw object at avatar anchor
    // ExpressionOverride — temporarily override blend shapes
    // ScreenShake — shake screen/camera
}
```

### MockStreamEventSource (for demo/testing)

```kotlin
val mockSource = MockStreamEventSource(
    config = MockConfig(intervalMs = 2000),
    platform = StreamPlatform.TWITCH,
)
mockSource.connect()
mockSource.events.collect { event -> /* random fake events */ }
```

### TwitchEventSubSource

```kotlin
val twitchSource = TwitchEventSubSource(
    config = TwitchConfig(
        accessToken = "your-oauth-token",
        clientId = "your-client-id",
        broadcasterId = "your-broadcaster-user-id",
    ),
)
twitchSource.connect()
twitchSource.events.collect { event -> /* real Twitch events */ }
```

### YouTubeLiveChatSource

```kotlin
val youtubeSource = YouTubeLiveChatSource(
    config = YouTubeConfig(
        apiKey = "your-api-key",
        accessToken = "your-oauth-token",
    ),
)
youtubeSource.connect()
youtubeSource.events.collect { event -> /* real YouTube events */ }
```

### StreamEventAggregator (multi-platform)

```kotlin
val aggregator = StreamEventAggregator()
aggregator.addSource(twitchSource)
aggregator.addSource(youtubeSource)
aggregator.connectAll()
aggregator.events.collect { event -> /* unified stream from all platforms */ }
```

### DefaultStreamBindings (in kmp-facelink-actions)

Pre-configured ActionBindings for common stream interaction patterns:

```kotlin
val actionSystem = ActionSystem()
actionSystem.register(DefaultStreamBindings.giftThrow())           // action ID: "stream.gift.throw"
actionSystem.register(DefaultStreamBindings.raidScreenShake())      // action ID: "stream.raid.shake"
actionSystem.register(DefaultStreamBindings.channelPointExpression( // action ID: "stream.channelpoint.expression"
    rewardTitle = "Smile!",
    blendShapes = mapOf(BlendShape.MOUTH_SMILE_LEFT to 1.0f, BlendShape.MOUTH_SMILE_RIGHT to 1.0f),
))

// Feed stream events to the action system
source.events.collect { event ->
    val actions = actionSystem.processStreamEvent(event)
    // actions contain ActionEvent.Started with the action IDs above
}
```

### Sample App INTERACT Mode

The sample app (Android and iOS) includes an INTERACT demo screen that:
- Uses MockStreamEventSource to generate fake events every 2 seconds
- Registers giftThrow and raidScreenShake bindings
- Displays a scrolling event log and an action feed

## VMC Module: kmp-facelink-vmc

VMC Protocol (OSC over UDP) for VRM apps.

```kotlin
// Send
val sender = VmcSender(VmcConfig(host = "192.168.1.100", port = 39539))
sender.start(faceTracker.trackingData, coroutineScope)

// Receive
val receiver = VmcReceiver(VmcConfig(port = 39539))
receiver.start(coroutineScope)
receiver.messages.collect { message -> /* handle */ }
```

## IFM Module: kmp-facelink-ifm

iFacialMocap protocol output, compatible with VTube Studio as a MeowFace replacement.

## Stream Module: kmp-facelink-stream (Experimental)

WebSocket streaming server for phone-as-tracker use cases. JVM only.

## VTS Module: kmp-facelink-vts

Direct VTube Studio Plugin API integration via WebSocket.

## Common Use Cases

### VTuber Avatar Driving

```kotlin
val tracker = createFaceTracker(context, FaceTrackerConfig())
val mapper = Live2DParameterMapper()
tracker.start()
tracker.trackingData.collect { data ->
    val params = mapper.map(data)
    live2dModel.setParameterValues(params)
}
```

### Phone as Wireless Tracker

```kotlin
val tracker = createFaceTracker(context)
val sender = VmcSender(VmcConfig(host = "192.168.1.100"))
sender.start(tracker.trackingData, scope)
```

### AI Avatar Chatbot

```kotlin
val pipeline = buildAvatarPipeline {
    llm(LlmConfig.Hybrid(
        onDeviceConfig = LlmConfig.OnDevice(modelId = "gemma-3n-e2b-int4"),
        cloudConfig = LlmConfig.OpenAi(apiKey = "sk-..."),
        routingStrategy = RoutingStrategy.Auto(complexityThreshold = 0.5f),
    ))
    persona(PersonaConfig(name = "Assistant"))
}
pipeline.start()
pipeline.listen()
pipeline.output.collect { frame -> /* render avatar + play audio */ }
```

### Gesture-Controlled Actions

```kotlin
val actions = ActionSystem()
actions.register(
    ActionBinding(trigger = GestureTrigger(HandGesture.THUMB_UP, holdTimeMs = 300))
)
actions.events.collect { event -> /* handle */ }
handTracker.trackingData.collect { actions.processHand(it) }
```

### Stream Interaction (Audience → Avatar Effects)

```kotlin
val source = MockStreamEventSource() // or TwitchEventSubSource / YouTubeLiveChatSource
val actionSystem = ActionSystem()
actionSystem.register(DefaultStreamBindings.giftThrow())
actionSystem.register(DefaultStreamBindings.raidScreenShake())
source.connect()
source.events.collect { event ->
    val actions = actionSystem.processStreamEvent(event)
    actions.forEach { action ->
        when (action.actionId) {
            "stream.gift.throw" -> { /* render ThrowEffect */ }
            "stream.raid.shake" -> { /* render ScreenShake */ }
        }
    }
}
```

## Gradle Plugin (Not Yet Published)

Plugin ID: `io.github.rioX432.facelink` — exists in the codebase (`gradle-plugin/`) but is **not yet published** to the Gradle Plugin Portal. It will be available after the first tagged release.

Once published, it will automate MediaPipe model downloads for Android with SHA-256 checksum verification:

```kotlin
// build.gradle.kts (available after first release)
plugins {
    id("io.github.rioX432.facelink")
}

faceLink {
    faceEnabled.set(true)   // default: true  — face_landmarker_v2_with_blendshapes.task (~5 MB)
    handEnabled.set(true)   // default: true  — hand_landmarker.task (~12 MB)
    bodyEnabled.set(false)  // default: false — pose_landmarker_lite.task (~8 MB)
    precision.set("float16") // default: "float16"
}
```

Until then, download models manually — see the [Android Quick Start](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/quick-start-android.md) for instructions.

## Dependency Setup

### Gradle (Android / KMP)

```kotlin
// build.gradle.kts
// NOTE: The Gradle plugin is not yet published. Download models manually for now.
// plugins { id("io.github.rioX432.facelink") }  // available after first release

dependencies {
    implementation("io.github.rioX432:kmp-facelink:0.2.0")
    implementation("io.github.rioX432:kmp-facelink-avatar:0.2.0")   // optional
    implementation("io.github.rioX432:kmp-facelink-actions:0.2.0")  // optional
    implementation("io.github.rioX432:kmp-facelink-interact:0.2.0") // optional — stream event sources
}
```

### Swift Package Manager (iOS)

```swift
// Package.swift
dependencies: [
    .package(url: "https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink", from: "0.1.0"),
]
```

SPM products: KMPFaceLink, KMPFaceLinkAvatar, KMPFaceLinkActions, KMPFaceLinkInteract, KMPFaceLinkVoice, KMPFaceLinkLlm, KMPFaceLinkPipeline, KMPFaceLinkNetworking, KMPFaceLinkVMC, KMPFaceLinkIFM.

## Android Requirements

- Min SDK 24
- CAMERA permission (runtime request required)
- MediaPipe model files in `assets/models/` — download manually (the Gradle plugin `io.github.rioX432.facelink` is not yet published; see Android Quick Start)
- PlatformContext requires both Context and LifecycleOwner

## iOS Requirements

- iOS 17.0+, Xcode 16+
- NSCameraUsageDescription in Info.plist
- TrueDepth front camera (face tracking only)
- arkit in UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities
- SKIE bridges Kotlin Flow to Swift AsyncSequence (for await syntax)
- K/N adds "do" prefix to init-prefixed functions (e.g., initKoin -> doInitKoin), but SKIE generates async extensions without the prefix

## iOS Swift Usage Example

```swift
import KMPFaceLink

let tracker = FaceTrackerFactoryKt.createFaceTracker(
    platformContext: PlatformContext(),
    config: FaceTrackerConfig()
)

Task {
    try? await tracker.start()
    for await data in tracker.trackingData {
        if data.isTracking {
            let jawOpen = data.blendShapes[BlendShape.jawOpen] ?? 0
        }
    }
}
```

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Shared (KMP) | Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Ktor Client |
| Android | MediaPipe, CameraX, Jetpack Compose |
| iOS | ARKit, Vision, SwiftUI |
| JVM/Desktop | ONNX Runtime, JavaCV |
| Wasm | MediaPipe JS interop, WebAssembly GC |
| Interop | SKIE (Swift-Kotlin Flow bridging) |

## Repository Structure

- `kmp-facelink/` — Core library (commonMain, androidMain, iosMain, jvmMain, wasmJsMain)
- `kmp-facelink-avatar/` — Avatar parameter mapping module
- `kmp-facelink-actions/` — Action and gesture trigger module
- `kmp-facelink-voice/` — Voice (ASR/TTS/LipSync) module
- `kmp-facelink-llm/` — LLM streaming module
- `kmp-facelink-pipeline/` — AI avatar pipeline module
- `kmp-facelink-networking/` — Shared networking utilities
- `kmp-facelink-vmc/` — VMC Protocol module
- `kmp-facelink-ifm/` — iFacialMocap protocol module
- `kmp-facelink-interact/` — Streaming platform event sources (Twitch, YouTube, Mock)
- `kmp-facelink-stream/` — WebSocket streaming module
- `kmp-facelink-vts/` — VTube Studio integration module
- `gradle-plugin/` — Gradle plugin for automated MediaPipe model downloads
- `androidApp/` — Android sample app
- `iosApp/` — iOS sample app (XcodeGen from project.yml)
- `docs/` — Documentation
